summary: Rewrote q1-q5 to remove recommended answers, preferred scope decisions, and validation policy from question text.

items.title: 1. q1 includes a recommended answer
items.rationale: Removed the recommendation and kept only the timeout retry decision question with a short timeout definition.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question now asks whether timeout calls should be retryCount targets.

items.title: 2. q2 includes a recommended scope decision
items.rationale: Removed the preferred scope exclusion and kept only the timeout limit scope question.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[1].question now asks whether default timeout or timeout limit changes are included.

items.title: 3. q3 includes a recommended implementation detail
items.rationale: Removed the preferred preview length and kept a neutral diagnostics question with a definition.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question now asks whether thrown errors should include stdout preview.

items.title: 4. q4 includes a recommended internal policy
items.rationale: Removed the preferred testing/profile policy and kept only the output normalization scope question.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[3].question now asks whether codex provider output normalization changes are included.

items.title: 5. q5 includes a recommended validation plan
items.rationale: Removed the preferred validation plan and kept only the long-running codex reproduction test decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[4].question now asks whether long-running real codex CLI reproduction tests are acceptance criteria.
